High-Flow Spray · Storage Protection

Large K-Factor & ESFR Sprinklers

Two related but distinct product groups: large K-factor spray sprinklers for higher discharge capacity, and ESFR sprinklers for storage-protection applications. Match the exact model and operating element before ordering.
